about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Serving the environment since 1994
about.description: Vilà Vila Serveis Ambientals SL is a company specialized in the comprehensive management of all types of waste. Founded in 1994 in Sant Joan de Vilatorrada (Bages), we offer waste collection, transport, management and recycling services with a commitment to protecting the environment.
about.history: Originally established as Contenidors Vilà Vila S.L., the company has evolved to become a benchmark in environmental management in central Catalonia, with offices in Bages, Osona and Vallès.
about.certificationsDesc: We hold ISO 9001:2015 (quality), ISO 14001:2015 (environment) and UNE-EN 15713:2010 (confidential destruction) certifications. Recognized with the EcoVadis Silver Medal for the third consecutive year.
